subject.title: feat(channels): add typed cross-surface approval actions

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the new public Plugin SDK approval, URL, and web-app action variants with the proposed deprecated legacy compatibility paths?
rationale: This expands a shipped plugin contract and establishes permanent cross-channel semantics; implementation tests cannot decide whether maintainers want to support this API direction long term.

options.title: Adopt typed actions
options.body: Approve the public variants, retain the deprecated compatibility paths, and require conflict resolution plus live proof before merge.

options.title: Keep actions internal
options.body: Remove or defer the external Plugin SDK expansion and keep typed approvals limited to bundled internal surfaces until a narrower public API is agreed.

recommendation.title: Adopt typed actions
recommendation.body: Approve the public variants, retain the deprecated compatibility paths, and require conflict resolution plus live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the durable approval lifecycle and authored the proposed typed-action contract and follow-up fixes.
